definitions.explanation: The pursuit of physical or sensory pleasure. Often carries a negative connotation of excessive or self-indulgent pleasure.

examples.japanese: {享楽|きょうらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耽|ふけ}る。
{享楽|きょうらく}{的|てき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: They are living a hedonistic lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{享楽|きょうらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えなかった→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I only chased pleasure and didn't think about the future.

notes:
Composed of {享|きょう} (to receive/enjoy) + ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ (pleasure/ease). Refers to the pursuit or enjoyment of sensory pleasures, usually with a negative or cautionary nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {享楽|きょうらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耽|ふけ}る: to indulge in pleasure
- {享楽|きょうらく}{的|てき}: hedonistic, pleasure-seeking
- {享楽|きょうらく}{主義|しゅぎ}: hedonism (as a philosophy)
- {享楽|きょうらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to chase after pleasure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{快楽|かいらく}→快楽：27770_kairaku⟧: pleasure, delight — focuses on the pleasure itself rather than the pursuit
- ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧: entertainment, recreation — neutral, everyday word for amusement
- {道楽|どうらく}: hobby or pastime, often with a sense of extravagance

{享楽|きょうらく} is more literary and morally loaded than ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧. It implies giving oneself over to pleasure, often at the expense of duty or discipline.
